source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.6 with Example 9.6 (PDF 204-205).

blocks.text: Jab charge q wala zarra potential V_A wale nuqte A se potential V_B wale nuqte B tak electrostatic tawazun rakhte hue jaye to us ki potential energy mein tabdeeli delta U = q(V_B - V_A) = q delta V ... (9.24) hai. Agar tawazun qaim rakhne ke liye charge par koi bairooni force na lage to potential energy ki yeh tabdeeli kinetic energy ki tabdeeli ban kar zahir hoti hai.

Maan lein zarre par charge q = e = 1.6 x 10^-19 C hai. Charge ki hasil ki gayi energy delta K.E. = q delta V = e delta V = (1.6 x 10^-19 C)(delta V). Agar delta V = 1 volt ho to delta K.E. = (1.6 x 10^-19 C) x (1 V) = 1.6 x 10^-19 J.

blocks.title: Electron volt
blocks.text: 1.6 x 10^-19 J ke barabar energy ki miqdar ek electron volt kehlati hai, 1 eV se zahir. Yeh woh energy hai jo electron ek volt ka potential difference paar karte hue hasil karta ya khota hai: 1 eV = 1.6 x 10^-19 J ... (9.25).

blocks.title: Example 9.6
blocks.text: 2e charge wala zarra 3.0 V ke potential difference se guzarta hai. Us ki hasil ki gayi energy nikalein. Hal: q = 2e, delta V = 3.0 V. delta K.E. = q delta V = (2e)(3.0 V) = 6.0 eV = 6.0 x 1.6 x 10^-19 J = 9.6 x 10^-19 J.

blocks.prompt: Electron volt potential difference ki unit hai ya energy ki (short question 9.4)? 100 volts ka potential difference electron par kitna kaam karta hai (MCQ 9.4)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh energy ki unit hai: 1 eV woh energy hai jo electron 1 V paar kar ke hasil karta ya khota hai, 1.6 x 10^-19 J ke barabar; potential difference ki unit volt hai, electron volt nahi. 100 V par kaam W = e x 100 V = 100 eV, option (d), jo 1.6 x 10^-17 J hai.

items: delta U = q delta V (9.24); bairooni force na ho to kinetic energy ban jati hai. 1 eV = electron ki 1 V paar karne par hasil ya khoi energy = 1.6 x 10^-19 J (9.25); energy ki unit. Example 9.6: 2e 3.0 V se 6.0 eV = 9.6 x 10^-19 J hasil karta hai.
